# Zaprite for Hermes

Receive money on Zaprite from an agent. One `checkoutUrl` for card, bank, Lightning, on-chain bitcoin, and stablecoins the org has already connected. Re-fetch until Paid. Do not trust a webhook body.

## When to use

- Invoice or one-amount checkout, then hand over `checkoutUrl`.
- Watch an order until Paid and mark it complete after delivery.
- Lightning or on-chain quote (`paymentUrl`) for the same order.
- Overdue invoices, a first-page report, a saved-profile charge the person approved.
- Check in a ticket for an event that already exists.

## When not to use

- The agent is paying. This plugin receives.
- Creating an org, an API key, a rail, a checkout, a payment link, a recurring invoice, an event, or a refund. Those writes are not in the API. Listing an existing payment link is fine.
- Treating `{eventType, orderId, orgId}` as payment. It is unsigned and id-only. `GET /v1/orders/{id}`.

## How to call

Hermes, first:

```bash
hermes plugins install "$PWD" --yes-deps
hermes plugins enable zaprite
```

Tools are `zaprite_*`. Secret `ZAPRITE_API_KEY` comes from Hermes (`agent.secret_scope.get_secret`), created at https://app.zaprite.com/org/default/settings/api

Outside Hermes: `Authorization: Bearer` to `https://api.zaprite.com/v1`. See AGENTS.md. There is no MCP server in this version.
